**Summary of fixes applied (informed by axe-core 4.11):**

1. **`color-contrast` (serious)** — dark deal card text `#d6d2c5` was failing because the card background was a layered SVG; axe saw white. Added `background-color: #1f4536` fallback to `.deals-card.dark` (and a neutral fallback to all `.deals-card`).
2. **`color-contrast` (serious)** — countdown labels (`#6b6b66` over translucent tile) hit 4.11:1; darkened to `#4a4a47`.
3. **`definition-list` (serious)** — `<dl>` with `<strong>`/`<span>` children. Replaced with proper `<dt>`/`<dd>` and adjusted CSS to keep the value-above-label visual order.
4. **`aria-prohibited-attr` (incomplete → fix)** — `aria-label` on bare `<span>` price. Replaced with visible text + `.sr-only` description ("Sale price $28, original price $36.") so SR gets a clean reading without a prohibited ARIA attribute.
5. **`aria-valid-attr-value` (mobile, serious)** — `aria-controls="primary-nav"` referenced a non-existent id. Added `id="primary-nav"` to the `<nav>`.

Final result: **0 violations** at both 1280×900 and 360×720 (with mobile menu expanded). Files in the working directory: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `app.js`.
